prompt:
Use the attached image as the reference: the same adult Czech woman — the personification of Prague — seen off duty in her everyday life. Keep her face, eye colour, hair colour, skin tone and body exactly; change only her clothes, pose and place. Do not reuse earlier conversation images.

Output: one horizontal 3:2 image, 1536×1024.

Face: exactly the attached image's face — the same short midface and face length-to-width ratio; the camera angle, pose, bangs or a headpiece never make her face look longer or her jaw heavier.

Style: Korean MMORPG character artwork. A painterly face with naturally observed facial anatomy, subtle eyelid structure, and soft, realistic shading across the nose and cheeks. 2D painting with visible brushwork: layered strokes of colour, soft broken edges, thin coloured linework and a few crisp accents on the face and costume.
SKIN FINISH: dewy, glass-like highlights on the skin of her shoulders, arms, collarbones and legs — a soft, luminous wet-look sheen that follows the body's forms; her face keeps a soft, natural finish.

She is strikingly beautiful and refined — harmonious features, clear luminous skin, graceful posture — while her own face stays distinct: her face shape, eyes, brows, nose and lips follow the attached image, not a generic pretty face.

World: an ordinary day in Prague as her world knows it — a far-future city two centuries from now: sleek curved architecture, smart glowing materials, holographic interfaces, layered levels of the city and quiet flying vehicles; even an everyday place is rebuilt in that future, not today's Prague with neon added. This is her world's own everyday life, not our present day: every made thing around her — tools, cups, lamps, signs, vehicles, money and devices — is made the way her world makes them.
Let the place itself carry this world through its materials, fittings and objects; do not add the city's landmarks, towers, giant holograms or a skyline unless the place below names them.

Place: a broad terrace on the hill above the river two centuries on where young people glide on anti-gravity boards, the old town and its bridges below.
Around her, as her world makes them: an anti-gravity board with glowing edges; a smart bottle with a glowing level line; a holographic phone screen projected from her wrist.
Season: autumn — cooling days, the park trees turning gold and red, and from mid-October cold foggy mornings over the river.
Weather: a windy day — a brisk west wind tugging at coats and hair and sweeping the sky clear.
Time of day: the evening rush after work — the warm low sun sinking into dusk and lamps coming on along the street; the warm low sun rim-lighting her hair.
Hair: a casual hat, cap or hood that suits the outfit, her hair showing beneath it — same colour and length as the attached image.
Light direction: side light — the light falls from one side, the far side of her face in soft shadow.
Outfit: a thin fitted turtleneck knit tucked into a tight high-waisted pencil skirt with a side slit, and heels — in rich jewel tones such as emerald, sapphire, amethyst or wine red; the outfit colour reads clearly at first glance; styled with sleeves pushed up to the elbows; right now — she has knotted the hem of her top up under her bust to keep it out of the way, baring her midriff and waist, worn with maximal styling presence — the chosen outfit worn in its most revealing version — a deep neckline with natural cleavage, bare shoulders, a cropped or open-back cut, a short hem or high slit showing the thighs, as far as the outfit allows, skin clearly showing, following her curvy figure — a slim waist and rounded hips; intimate areas covered.
Her clothes are her world's everyday techwear — the chosen outfit keeps its cut, cover and skin, but is made of technical fabrics with reflective panels, glowing seam lines, magnetic clasps and chunky-soled boots.
POSTURE: standing balanced on her board, feet set apart across it, knees softly bent, her silhouette steady.
COMPOSITION: an environmental long shot, her complete figure and enough of the place around her; body in side profile, her face in profile too, not turned toward the camera, facing the right of the frame, so her own right side is toward the camera; camera at her eye level; she is small in the lower part of the frame, the place rising above her; the space runs far back behind her, its lines receding into the distance.
Lens / perspective: 35mm-equivalent environmental perspective balancing the woman and the setting with moderate depth.
BOTH HANDS: both arms are held out wide for balance.
LEGS: knees softly bent, feet planted apart across the board.
GAZE: she looks toward the far distance.
EXPRESSION: slightly drawn brow, narrowed steady eyes, mouth firmly closed.

Leave behind everything she wears in the attached image — no crown, tiara, helmet, feathers, headpiece, hairpins from it, armour or regalia — and leave behind the object she holds in it; her hair is styled for the everyday outfit, with at most one small accessory.

SIGNATURE ACCESSORY: her world's signature object — a carved wooden marionette control bar strung with glowing ultraviolet threads that run down to a small dancing marionette of light — appears only as one small accessory shaped after it (a charm, brooch, pendant or hair ornament) or set down beside her in the scene; she does not hold it unless PROP names it.

Light: the place's own light, lit and coloured the way this style renders light and skin.

One figure in focus, natural hands with five fingers, no text, numbers, logo or watermark. No animals or other creatures.

observations: Wide view of hoverboard balance with two outstretched arms; turtleneck hem tied under the bust.
